articles.title: Hybrid AI will drive 'whole new wave' of opportunity in 2026
articles.mainIdea: Hybrid AI will drive 'whole new wave' of opportunity in 2026
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Hybrid AI will drive 'whole new wave' of opportunity in 2026. TECHnalysis Research, LLC President Bob O'Donnell sits down with Yahoo Finance markets and data editor Jared Blikre on Market Catalysts to discuss one of the biggest tech trends from the AI trade in 2025 — hybrid AI — and the opportunities that it will continue to present in 2026. Also catch Bob O'Donnell's predictions for agentic AI in 2026 — as it relates to cybersecurity usage — and who he anticipates to be Nvidia's (NVDA) biggest competitors next year. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts. Related tickers mentioned: CRM, CSCO, DELL, META, MSFT, NVDA.
